edit_targets.description: Optional explicit editable files (distinct workspace-relative files, Windows-safe names, links rejected). Each entry names exactly that one file; a same-named file in another folder is never matched. Omitted/null keeps the legacy scope derived from the goal/constraints prose; an explicit list replaces only the prose-inferred editable list, so protected/read-only files and carve-outs in the prose still apply (a conflict is rejected with 422), and an empty list grants no file edits (accepted only with allow_commands; otherwise 422). Every required_outputs entry must be inside this scope (required_outputs never grants write access). The scope is frozen at admission and persisted; framework guidance, corrective turns and restarts never change it. It limits file-tool targets only: it is not an OS sandbox and does not inspect what an allowed command writes. Requires mutate mode and remains bounded by the Agent's existing grants.
edit_targets.title: Edit Targets

execution_profile_id.description: Optional runtime ExecutionProfile for this task. Omitted/null keeps the pinned AgentRevision default. An explicit id must be a formal system Profile or an enabled Profile of the Agent's own Team; it never changes the Agent role and never falls back. provider/model/effort remain assertions against the selected route.
execution_profile_id.title: Execution Profile Id

required_outputs.description: Workspace-relative files the task must create or change. The task completes only when each is a safe, non-empty regular file whose streamed content digest differs from the one captured before the first model turn AND the task has write provenance: a successful file-tool write receipt for that path (file_tool), or a permitted command that completed cleanly (command_correlated: correlation only, command receipts carry only a whole-workspace freshness observation, not per-path mutation proof). An unchanged pre-existing file, a touch or an identical rewrite never satisfies. Requires mutate mode. Windows-safe relative names only; links and reparse points are rejected.
required_outputs.title: Required Outputs

requires_command_verification.description: Require successful command evidence after the last mutation point: a file-tool edit, or any command whose bounded before/after workspace content observation did not prove the workspace unchanged (changed, unknown, partial/over-limit, background launch, or no evidence; success does not matter). The last unproven command cannot verify itself. Observation is whole-workspace and bounded (excludes .git; unobservable links/reparse points or limits fail closed), not a per-path change list. An explicit boolean overrides language inference; omitted/null infers from the goal and completion criteria.
requires_command_verification.title: Requires Command Verification

tool_generation_max_tokens.description: Omitted/null keeps the model's legacy output reserve. Explicit per-task opt-in: uncapped tool generation may use a bounded allowance up to this many tokens (never above 4096 or the remaining context window); explicit caller/runtime caps still win.
tool_generation_max_tokens.title: Tool Generation Max Tokens
